title: Media Block
description: A standalone media section with optional caption and link. Supports DAM-backed images and video (DynamicImage, DynamicVideo) or URL-based ones (ManualImage, ExternalVideo).

href.title: Link
href.description: Optional URL — wraps the media in a link. External URLs open in a new tab. A video inside a link is always ambient, so the click goes to the link, and it plays only while the link is hovered or focused.

fullBleed.title: Full bleed
fullBleed.description: Extend the media edge-to-edge, ignoring container padding and max-width.

maxWidth.title: Max width
maxWidth.description: Ignored when full bleed is on.

customCss.title: Custom CSS (advanced)
customCss.description: Optional. CSS for this block only — it also reaches any blocks nested inside it. Bare declarations style the block itself (background: …); nested rules style what's inside (h2 { … }, &:hover { … }, @media … { … }); custom properties (--color-primary: …) flow down to child blocks. Leave blank for none.
